implementation_result_kernel_builder_202.what_the_prior_work_DID_achieve: The heal itself is correct and is retained unchanged. The new AC-118-2 tripwire non_uuid_proposal_id_is_admitted_only_on_the_legacy_heal_path PASSED, and migration_0345_old_schema_identity_and_down_up_retry_converge PASSED, so the MT-112 identity work is green.
implementation_result_kernel_builder_202.diagnosis_method: storage_error maps every non-Validation/NotFound/Conflict error to an opaque 500 and logs through tracing, but handshake_core installs no tracing subscriber under test, so the cause was invisible. A temporary eprintln was added to storage_error, the single test was re-run with --nocapture, the cause was captured, and the instrumentation was REMOVED - verified by grep returning 0 occurrences. Same technique MT-112 had to use for the same opacity.
implementation_result_kernel_builder_202.root_cause_captured_verbatim: MT118_TEMP_DIAGNOSTIC storage_error: serialization error: HSK-400-INVALID-EVENT: Event shape violation: payload field proposal_id must be a UUID string: invalid character: expected an optional prefix of urn:uuid: followed by [0-9a-fA-F-], found P at 1
implementation_result_kernel_builder_202.the_real_defect: validate_memory_write_proposed_payload (flight_recorder/mod.rs) required proposal_id to be a UUID via require_uuid_string_non_nil, while its OWN SIBLINGS in the same event family - FR-EVT-MEM-002 at :4228 and FR-EVT-MEM-003 at :4270 - accept require_safe_token_string(.., proposal_id, 256) for the SAME logical field. The family contradicted itself: a proposal could be REVIEWED with a non-UUID id but never PROPOSED with one, so a pre-hardening row could never publish FR-EVT-MEM-001 and its retry could never converge.
implementation_result_kernel_builder_202.fix: Aligned FR-EVT-MEM-001 proposal_id to require_safe_token_string(map, proposal_id, 256), matching MEM-002 and MEM-003. is_safe_token still enforces non-empty, <=256 bytes, and an ASCII charset of alphanumerics plus -_:./ so no whitespace, quotes, or control characters are admitted. UUID discipline for NEWLY MINTED proposals remains enforced upstream in build_memory_proposal_flight_recorder_event and is pinned by the AC-118-2 tripwire. Neither event_id nor the aggregate id depend on this field - both are stable_uuid derivations - so a non-UUID payload id cannot produce a non-UUID durable key.

evidence_that_this_changes_no_real_data.claim: No genuine pre-hardening non-UUID proposal row exists anywhere in the live cluster.
evidence_that_this_changes_no_real_data.method: Scanned every schema holding fems_memory_proposals across the managed cluster with a dynamic-SQL sweep.
evidence_that_this_changes_no_real_data.result: 66 proposal rows total, 4 with a non-UUID proposal_id. All four are PROP-LEGACY-<uuidv7> values sitting in leaked storage_test_* schemas - fixtures left behind by this very test.
evidence_that_this_changes_no_real_data.corroboration: PROP-LEGACY appears exactly 4 times in the entire source tree, all inside api/memory.rs test fixtures. It is not a production shape.
evidence_that_this_changes_no_real_data.consequence: This is why the fix was NOT keyed on a PROP-LEGACY- prefix: doing so would have shaped product law around a test fixture. It also means the alignment cannot re-key, widen, or reinterpret any existing row.

scope.summary: Let a pre-hardening FEMS memory proposal row that has no _canonical_artifact retry successfully, without weakening the canonical proposal contract for normal rows.

defect_detail.real_error: Serialization("memory proposal artifact is not hsk.memory_write_proposal@0.1: missing field schema_version"), obtained by MT-112 through temporary instrumentation of storage_error which was then removed.
defect_detail.mechanism: A pre-hardening legacy row has no _canonical_artifact, so proposal_artifact_value (storage/fems_memory.rs:279-290) returns the raw payload and build_memory_proposal_flight_recorder_event (:996-1001) cannot parse it.
defect_detail.why_reconstruction_alone_fails: fems_memory.rs:1003-1004 requires canonical.proposal_id == proposal.proposal_id AND Uuid::parse_str(&canonical.proposal_id).is_ok(). The legacy fixture id is PROP-LEGACY-{uuid}, so NO artifact can satisfy both constraints. The contract itself must change for legacy non-UUID ids.
defect_detail.determinism: Reproduced deterministically in isolation in 3.37s with zero contention - not the cargo/PostgreSQL starvation hazard, and not a race: both concurrent retries fail identically.
defect_detail.origin: Commit 892662e0, a WIP checkpoint - the same commit that introduced the Rust/SQL identity split MT-112 fixed.

scope.recommended_shape_from_mt112_for_authori: Heal _canonical_artifact from DURABLE COLUMNS ONLY, mirroring the existing "Pre-hardening rows cannot recover the headers" branch at fems_memory.rs:606-623 so concurrent retries converge byte-for-byte, and admit a legacy non-UUID proposal_id ONLY on that heal path. This is a recommendation, not an authorized decision.
acceptance_criteria: AC-118-1: legacy_retry_heals_missing_receipt_once_and_converges passes against real PostgreSQL WITHOUT weakening or deleting any assertion.

AC-118-2: the legacy non-UUID proposal_id is admitted ONLY on the heal path. A NORMAL proposal with a non-UUID id must still be rejected - prove that with a negative test, or the contract has been globally weakened.
AC-118-3: concurrent retries against a healed legacy row converge BYTE-FOR-BYTE (the failing test drives two; both must reach the same durable outcome).
AC-118-4: the heal derives ONLY from durable columns. It must never fabricate provenance that was not persisted.
AC-118-5: MT-112 canonical identity work stays green - both the differential test and migration_0345_old_schema_identity_and_down_up_retry_converge still pass.
proof_targets: PT-118-1: the named test green against real PostgreSQL, with the RED reproduced first.
PT-118-2: a negative test proving a non-legacy proposal with a non-UUID id is still rejected.
PT-118-3: the full api::memory:: suite green (MT-112 left it at 27 passed / 1 failed; this MT should make it 28+/0).
